To 5 months Imprisonment on 16.12.31.
At 6.40 p.m. November 7, 1931 about 40 Chinese
youths carrying a red cloth banner inscribed with the
usual communistic slogans entered the International
Settlement from the French Concession where they had
attacked several tramcars and proceeded along Chekiang
Road to Hupeh Road where they stoned tramcars and
two trailers breaking 14 panes of glass. During
the disturbance, the mob shouted "Down with Chiang Kai
Shek". Two Chinese policemen were assaulted and
injured by the mob, accused being one of the number.

ings Mr. Peu Tsoh appeared for the appellant.
Mr. Lee:-Recoutines the charge and added on the 7-11-31 which
is the anniversary of the Soviet Republic, the accused with over 100
others came into the Settlement from French Town. When near Foochow
Rd; C.P.C. 1185 saw the crowd who were shouting slogans and carrying
a red flag. They also broke the windows of a tramcar. The C.P.C.
attempted to stop them but he was assaulted and knocked down and
some one hit him with an iron bar.
When C.P.C. 2632 went to his assistance the accused was standing
near him. The C.P.C. attempted to arrest him but he was also assaulted.
assaulted. C.P.C. 1806 then came to the scene and with his assist-
ance the accused was taken to the Station. Both the C.P.C.s were
injured, one on the head and the other on the head and testicles.
C.P.C. 2632:-Repeats his evidence of the last hearing.
C.P.C. 1806:-Corroborated C.P.C. 2632.
C.P.C. 1185:-Corroborated and added that at the time in question
I saw the crowd coming from French Town and I went to telephone the
Station when the crowd assaulted me, when I was on the ground some-
one also kicked me. I could not tell who it was that assaulted me
or gave me the kick when I was on the ground.
I heard the crowd shouting "down with the Imperialists and the
Kuomintang and protect the Soviet Russia.
Mr. Lee, in answer to the Judge:-The Foreign detective is not in
Court.
C.D.C. 216:-Repeats the evidence of the C.P.C.s and added that accus-
ed stated that he took supper at 1642 Sinza Rd. I found blood on the
accused clothing on the accused and also on his shoes.
Judge to Mr. Lee:-Have you got the doctors certificate of the inju-
ries of the C.P.C.s.
Mr. Lee:-Accused was charged with Anti-Revolution so the doctors cer-
tificate was not brought to Court, if the Court requires them I will
them for the next hearing.

于11月7日被捕。
诉讼过程 李先生代表警方出庭。 J. H. 21.
Peu Tsoh 先生代表上诉人出庭。
李先生：- 确认指控并补充说，在1931年11月7日，即苏维埃共和国周年纪念日，被告与其他100多人从法租界进入租界。当靠近福州路时，华捕1185号看到人群高呼口号并手持红旗。他们还砸坏了一辆电车的窗户。该华捕试图阻止他们，但遭到袭击并被击倒，有人用铁棍击打他。
当华捕2632号前去协助时，被告正站在他附近。该华捕试图逮捕他，但也遭到袭击。
华捕1806号随后赶到现场，在其协助下，被告被带往捕房。两名华捕均受伤，一人头部受伤，另一人头部及睾丸受伤。
华捕2632号：- 重复上次听证会的证词。
华捕1806号：- 佐证华捕2632号的证词。
华捕1185号：- 佐证并补充说，在当时我看到人群从法租界方向过来，我正要去打电话给捕房时遭到人群袭击，当我倒在地上时，有人踢了我。我无法辨认是谁袭击了我或在我倒地时踢了我。
我听到人群高呼“打倒帝国主义者和国民党，保护苏俄”。
李先生回答法官提问：- 外籍侦探不在法庭。
华探216号：- 重复华捕的证词并补充说，被告称他在新闸路1642号吃了晚饭。我在被告的衣服和鞋子上发现了血迹。
法官问李先生：- 你有华捕受伤的医生证明吗？
李先生：- 被告被控反革命罪，因此医生证明未带上法庭，如果法庭需要，我将在下次听证会时带来。

被告：- 我在法租界来福卡7号的一家木匠店做工。我和朋友倪清明（Nyi Tsing Ming）在新闸路吃了晚饭。离开他家后我回家，但当我走到湖北路时被逮捕。我对袭击警察或向电车扔石头一事一无所知。当时另有三人与我同时被捕，但他们已被释放。我没有喊任何口号，我也不是共产党员。我衣服和鞋子上的血迹是华捕用警棍击打我臀部时造成的。我从未抓过任何人的睾丸。

My name is Lee Kwei Foo (呂貴富) and was born at Wenchow
(温州) in 1907. Prior to 1928. I lived at 11 Wang Kai (橫街)
of West Gate, Wenchow. When I was nine years old I attended school,
and in my tenth year started work as a carpenter. In 1928. I came
to Shanghai where I met a fellow countryman named Woo Mai Zoo (吳梅祖)
This man introduced me to another fellow countryman named Ziang
at 150. Rue de Saigon. This man gave me employment at that
address as a carpenter and I remained there till the New Year
1931. when I returned to Wenchow. I returned to Shanghai in
June 1931. and again worked at the same shop. On 7-11-31. I
went to the shop of a fellow countryman in search of a friend
named Yih Ching Ming, but could not find him. I remained at the
shop and had dinner, returning at about 6-0.p.m. by tramcar from
Sinsa Rd to Nanking Rd. I left the car at the Wing On Co and
walked down Hupeh Rd where I saw a crowd of demonstrators. Whilst

At 9 p.m. 7-11-31, the accused was taken to the police Hospital. C.P.C. 1185 stated that he was on duty at the corner of Foochow and Hupeh Roads at about 6:55 p.m. when he saw a crowd walking north along Hupeh Rd. shouting slogans. As he approached them with a view to arresting one carrying a red flag, they attacked tram car and broke several windows. He succeeded in seizing the flag when he was attacked by the mob. He was then struck on the head with an iron bar and knocked to the ground. C.P.C. 2882 also detained in Hospital, stated that he was on duty at Hupeh Hankow Roads corner when he heard a police whistle and ran to Foochow Road where he saw C.P.C. 1185 on the ground, and a mob milling round. He seized the accused who was near the C.P.C. whereupon he was set about by the mob. C.P.C. 1808 then arrived and took over the accused. The accused denied having taken part in the demonstration although his shoes bore blood stains. He will appear before the S.S.D. Court on the 9-11-31. Charged under Art. 143 and 157 of the C.C.R.C. when a remand will be asked pending the recovery of the police witnesses now in Hospital.

At 9 a.m. 8-11-31 the accused was removed from the station cells and taken to 150 Rue Saigon where he stated he lived and was employed as a carpenter.

Para. 2 H.Ditz - alleged agent-provocateur.

We are advised that one named H.Dietz,German, apparently act-
ing on istructions of P.Libanoff ( Soyouzneft),is working as
an agent-provocateur in connection with the boycott of Japa-
nese goods in Shanghai. He visits local Chinese firms and
asks for Japanese goods on the pretext of re-selling them to
Germans, and then communicates the addresses to the Anti-Japa-
nese Associations.

Para.14. Activities of the Chinese Communist Party.

At about 6.50 p.m. on the 7th inst., about 30 communists as-
sembled together at Rue Falicao and Rue de Ningpoo,French Con-
cession ,and shouted" Long leave the Chinese Communist Party".
The demonstrators then proceeded in eastern direction and, at
the corner of the Rue de Consulat and Rue they smashed four
windows of tramcars No 12 and 23 (Route No 5) of the French
Tramway Co. Proceeding then towards the North the communists
attacked tramcar No 3( Route No 5) of the same company sma-
shing two windows,in the vicinity of Avenue Ed.VII and Rue Hue.
Continuing their march they attacked again tramcar No 11 of the
French Tramway Co and tramcar No 49 of the International Co,at
the corner of the Hupeh and Pakhai Roads.

The International police arrested one of the demon-
strants named IU-KWEI-FU ( ),aged 21 years, native of
Wechow,an ex-employee of a furniture shop at No 150 Rue des
Pères. In the course of demonstration,Chinese policeman No 1185
of the Settlement Police, was grievously wounded by the crowd.
He was immediately sent to Hospital.

The following communist tracts were distributed in the course
of the demonstration: -

1.Commemorate the October Revolution !
2. Support the Soviet Government and Red Armies!
3. Down with the Japanese and all other Imperialists!

第2段 H.Ditz - 涉嫌挑衅代理人。

据告，一名名为 H.Dietz 的德国人，显然奉 P.Libanoff (Soyouzneft) 之指示行事，在上海抵制日货活动中充当挑衅代理人 (agent-provocateur)。他走访当地中国商号，借口将日货转售给德国人而索取日货，随即将地址通报给反日协会。

第14段. 中国共产党活动。

本月7日下午6点50分左右，约30名共产党人在法租界法利奥路 (Rue Falicao) 与宁波路 (Rue de Ningpoo) 交汇处聚集，高呼“拥护中国共产党”。示威者随后向东行进，在领事馆路 (Rue de Consulat) 与某路拐角处砸碎了法国电车公司5路线12号和23号电车的四扇窗户。随后向北行进，共产党人在爱多亚七世大道 (Avenue Ed.VII) 与霞飞路 (Rue Hue) 附近袭击了该公司同一路线的3号电车，砸碎两扇窗户。继续行进中，他们在湖北路与北海路 (Pakhai Roads) 拐角处再次袭击了法国电车公司的11号电车和国际公司的49号电车。

工部局警察逮捕了一名名为 IU-KWEI-FU ( ) 的示威者，年龄21岁，温州人，系神父路 (Rue des Pères) 150号一家家具店的前雇员。在示威过程中，租界警务处的华捕1185号被人群重伤。他随即被送往医院。

示威过程中散发了以下共产党传单：-

1. 纪念十月革命！
2. 拥护苏维埃政府和红军！
3. 打倒日本及一切其他帝国主义者！

At 6.55.p.m. a telephone message was received
from Central to the effect that a communistic demons-
tration was taking place on Foochow Road. On the
arrival of a party of Police from this Station the
demonstrators had dispersed. A red banner bearing
a Hammer and sickle and the following slogans was
found on Foochow Road.

At 7.00.p.m. C.P.C. 1808 brought to the station
C.P.C.s 2882,1185 and the accused whom he arrested in
the act of assaulting C.P.C. 9882. Both C.P.C.s are
now detained in the Police Hospital pending medical
examination. As far as can be ascertained the rabble
had come from Frenchtown and were going to Foochow
Road. A further report will be forwarded when more
particulars have been obtained.

J. Boyne.
